tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark value is the old site's `primary`.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Panels and cards: the contact form panel, the mobile menu sheet.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Nested fills: media placeholders, a hovered row, the select menu's active option.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a surface-2 fill.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: the six strings, row dividers, tag outlines. Never the only boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries that must be seen: input underlines, outline button borders. 3:1 or better on ground, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings, on ground and every surface. Also the primary button's fill, with ground as its label.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: summaries, descriptions, inactive nav links. On ground, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text: years, eyebrow labels, placeholders, footer notes. On ground, surface-1 and surface-2.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Peach, as a fill only. One accent-filled control per view (the header's Hire me button), and the hover state of the primary button. Value carried from the old site.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill of an accent control. Value carried from the old site.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover fills. Never white.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Peach as a mark or text on ground, surface-1, surface-2 and accent-soft: the wordmark's dot, the active nav underline, the plucked string, hovered arrows.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind accent-ink text, for a highlighted note.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Availability dot and success messages; as text on ground, surface-1 or positive-soft. A bluish green, so it stays apart from danger for red-green colour blindness. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a success note, behind positive text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors; as text on ground, surface-1 or danger-soft. Always paired with an icon and a message.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error note, behind danger text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus colour, an alias of accent-ink. 3:1 or better on every ground and surface in both themes.

families.sans: "Instrument Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Sans Thai", ui-monospace, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Instrument Sans at medium weight, set tight. Desktop sizes; scale down with the clamp values in the README.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero statement. Once per site.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Section openers, a case study's title, the contact call.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Project names in the work index.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Service names, card titles.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Roles in the timeline, form group titles.

groups.name: Thai
groups.note: Thai falls to IBM Plex Sans Thai. Heavier, looser and untracked, because Thai stacks marks above and below the line.

styles.name: th-display
styles.sample: ระบบหลังบ้านที่ทำตามงานจริง
styles.usage: Thai section openers and the hero. Break lines by hand.

styles.name: th-title
styles.sample: ระบบจัดการรถรับส่งพนักงาน
styles.usage: Thai project names in the work index.

styles.name: th-heading
styles.sample: รับทำระบบหลังบ้าน
styles.usage: Thai service names and card titles.

styles.name: th-lead
styles.sample: ผมเริ่มจากนั่งดูว่าทีมคุณทำงานยังไง แล้วทำระบบให้ตรงกับงานนั้น
styles.usage: The paragraph under a Thai headline.

styles.name: th-body
styles.sample: ย้ายงานจาก Excel และ LINE มาอยู่ในระบบเดียว
styles.usage: Thai running text.

styles.name: th-label
styles.usage: Thai eyebrows, field labels and the status pill. Never uppercased or tracked.

groups.name: Expression
groups.note: Newsreader italic, the way sheet music sets its expression marks. One word or phrase inside a display line, never a whole heading.

styles.name: expression-xl
styles.usage: The expression mark inside display-xl. Latin words only.

styles.name: expression-lg
styles.usage: The expression mark inside display-lg.

styles.name: expression-md
styles.usage: The expression mark inside display-md.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters. Thai falls to IBM Plex Sans Thai; give it line-height 1.8.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: I start by watching how your team works, then build the system to match.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display heading.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Move the work out of spreadsheets and chat into one system, with user roles and a history of every change.
styles.usage: Everything else.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: A bilingual site that loads fast and that your team can edit.
styles.usage: Card summaries, form messages, nav links and button labels.

groups.name: Utility
groups.note: JetBrains Mono, the old site's only face, kept for the small print.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, field labels, the status pill. Uppercase through CSS, sentence case in the markup.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Years, stack names, footer notes. Tabular figures.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline code and snippets in case studies.

spacing.note: 4px base. Sections breathe at space-24 and space-32; nothing sits closer than space-2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Underline offset, dot to label inside the status pill.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, gap between tags, label to field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pitch of the six strings, tag and input padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading and its text, page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Row padding in the work index, button padding, page gutter from 768px.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between nav links, between form fields.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between a section heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on phones, top of the contact call.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Section padding on tablets.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding from 1200px.

radius.note: Square by default. Hairlines separate things; corners only soften media, panels and pills.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Project media, notes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels: the contact form, the mobile menu. The old site's card radius.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, tags, the status pill.

shadow.note: Borders, not shadows. One shadow for things that float, one ring for focus.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The mobile menu sheet and the select menu.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons and links: a 2px gap in the ground colour, then 2px of solid focus colour.

motion.note: One tempo: 120 BPM, so a beat is 500ms. Every duration is a note value of that beat.

tokens.name: tempo-32nd
tokens.usage: Stagger step between siblings: strings, rows, tags.

tokens.name: tempo-16th
tokens.usage: Colour and opacity feedback on hover and press; stagger between headline lines.

tokens.name: tempo-8th
tokens.usage: Small moves: an arrow's nudge, the plus turning, a row's title shifting.

tokens.name: tempo-beat
tokens.usage: One element entering: a reveal, a string drawing, a headline line rising.

tokens.name: tempo-half
tokens.usage: Slow moves: media scaling on hover, a page transition.

tokens.name: tempo-bar
tokens.usage: Ambient loops only: the availability dot's pulse.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Entrances and hover moves. In Motion: ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1].

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Toggles and things that move between two resting places.

tokens.name: ease-in
tokens.usage: Exits.

layout.note: One centred column, twelve tracks inside it.

tokens.name: container
tokens.usage: Maximum content width. The old site's xl container.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: rows stop stacking. Carried from the old site.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: the nav replaces the menu button; gutter grows to space-6.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: two-column sections.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: full display sizes and space-32 sections.

meta.note: Rebranded from the old portfolio to Silicon Warin on 2026-09-28; colour, spacing and breakpoint values are still the ones read from the repository.
